card.name: Choosing between dosage forms or products
card.fires_on: Words in dosing-section text that distinguish one formulation from another, such as the end of Noxafil before a form name, or the space before a dose amount like 200 mg. The setting is a label comparing tablets, suspension, vials, pens or granules.
